tips.1: Test yourself before re-reading: trying to recall an idea fixes it better than reading it again.
tips.2: Space it out: three short sessions on different days beat one long session the night before.
tips.3: Explain it in your own words, as if to a classmate. The parts you can't explain are the ones to review.
tips.4: Mix chapters when you practise: switching between kinds of problems teaches you to spot which method fits.
tips.5: After a mistake, write down why it was tempting. Next time you'll see the trap coming.
tips.6: Work in 25-minute blocks with a short break: a rested brain remembers more.
